description: Verbalization is not uniformly non-reactive: simple concurrent think-aloud had near-zero accuracy effect, while directed explanation/description changed performance and all verbal protocols increased time.
resolution_notes: Neta may elicit concrete description before vocabulary, but must not treat explanatory questioning as neutral measurement.

description: Think-aloud instructions, verbalization, evaluator interpretation and evaluator-user relationship can vary with cultural cognition.
resolution_notes: Do not encode one universal elicitation script; preserve room for language, relationship and communication-context adaptation.

description: Preferences for visual complexity and colorfulness vary strongly across participant backgrounds.
resolution_notes: Perceptual organization can be diagnosed structurally, but the preferred amount/intensity of visual complexity cannot be inferred from a universal aesthetic norm.

description: Hofstede-derived country/group predictions did not fully match observed design characteristics across 10 Arab countries.
resolution_notes: Country labels are sampling descriptors, not direct mechanisms for hierarchy rules.

description: A controlled study found aesthetics did not affect perceived usability, while usability affected post-use aesthetics, contrary to a simple beauty→usability causal reading.
resolution_notes: Split aesthetic appraisal from task usability and from perceived usability; do not infer causal direction from correlation.

description: Peak visual appeal for complexity/colorfulness varied by country, gender and education.
resolution_notes: Perceived modernity/craft and aesthetic preference require target-context evidence; structural coherence is not a complete proxy for liking.

description: Changing feedback type altered perceived waiting, but a feedback style that reduced perceived duration did not necessarily improve the short-wait experience.
resolution_notes: Separate actual latency, perceived duration, acknowledgement, progress comprehension and preference; do not use one as a proxy for the others.

description: Status feedback is useful but W3C explicitly warns that excessive live updates can make an interface too chatty.
resolution_notes: The capability is timely/salient acknowledgement appropriate to state and modality, not maximum feedback.

description: Across choice-overload experiments, fewer options had virtually zero mean benefit and large heterogeneity.
resolution_notes: Do not equate fewer elements/options with lower useful cognitive cost; diagnose task complexity and relevance.

description: Choice overload is not ubiquitous; some studies find no harm or benefits from more options.
resolution_notes: One-primary-action cannot be a universal visible-choice rule.

description: Choice set complexity, task difficulty, preference uncertainty and decision goal moderate overload.
resolution_notes: Classify execution/exploration mode and decision conditions before suppressing alternatives.

description: For inaccurate AI outputs, explanations increased trusting behavior rather than helping users reject bad outputs.
resolution_notes: Reject any rule that treats higher trust or more explanation as success. The target remains correctness-sensitive reliance.

description: US/China service-robot data found cultural dimensions moderated several trust/intention relationships.
resolution_notes: Trust presentation and interpretation may need context evidence; do not infer individual behavior from nationality.

description: Explanation affected behavioral reliance/accuracy differently from self-reported trust, especially by task capacity.
resolution_notes: Keep subjective trust, behavioral reliance and decision performance as separate outcomes.

description: Simple think-aloud and directed explanation have materially different reactivity profiles.
resolution_notes: Probe design must distinguish low-directiveness observation from explanatory intervention.

description: Asking intention/self-prediction questions has a measurable small effect on later behavior with moderators.
resolution_notes: A diagnostic question can become part of the intervention; timing and content are validity variables.

description: Updated RCT meta-analysis finds a smaller but persistent question-behavior effect with substantial heterogeneity and bias concerns.
resolution_notes: Do not assume probe reactivity is large or absent; preserve it as a measurable risk.

description: Adaptive testing improved precision but did not automatically improve experience and could increase effort.
resolution_notes: Information efficiency and subjective/cognitive cost must be assessed separately.
